function.name: create_polygon
function.description: Create a polygon shape with given vertices.

vertices.description: List of vertices (x, y) to define the shape.

is_closed.description: Whether to close the shape or not, i.e., connect the last vertex with the first vertex.

stroke_width.description: Stroke width of the shape outline. Default: 5
